job.title: Country HR Lead / Senior HR Business Partner | Financial Sector | 45M
job.description:

Japan represents an important market within the broader regional and global business, offering strong visibility and exposure to senior stakeholders both locally and internationally.

We are seeking an experienced HR leader to serve as the senior People Business Partner for the Japan business.

This position will act as the primary HR advisor to senior leadership, leading the people agenda across talent, employee relations, organizational effectiveness, workforce planning, governance, and business transformation.

While structured as an individual contributor role, the position carries significant influence and ownership, requiring a highly credible HR professional who can operate independently while partnering closely with regional and global stakeholders.

The successful candidate will combine strategic thinking with strong operational execution and thrive within a fast-paced, matrixed international environment.

Strategic HR Business Partnering

  • Partner with senior leaders to align people strategy with business objectives
  • Provide guidance on workforce planning, organizational effectiveness, performance management, and talent strategy
  • Support organizational change and transformation initiatives
  • Act as a trusted advisor on people, leadership, and business-related matters

Talent Management & Organizational Development

  • Support succession planning and leadership development initiatives

  • Partner with regional and global teams to implement talent strategies
  • Strengthen leadership effectiveness and organizational capability

Employee Relations & Compliance

  • Advise leaders on employment risk and regulatory matters
  • Ensure compliance with Japanese labor law and internal governance standards
  • Partner with legal and specialist HR functions on sensitive cases

Talent Acquisition & Workforce Planning

  • Partner closely with hiring managers and talent acquisition teams
  • Support workforce planning and critical hiring initiatives
  • Provide market insight and talent recommendations
  • Enhance recruitment processes and candidate experience

HR Operations & Governance

  • Support compensation and reward processes
  • Oversee key HR governance and compliance activities
  • Partner with internal stakeholders on audits, controls, and policy implementation
  • Ensure operational excellence across the employee lifecycle

Transformation & Innovation

  • Support HR modernization and process improvement initiatives
  • Identify opportunities to improve efficiency and employee experience
  • Contribute to discussions around technology, AI, and future ways of working

Qualifications

Required

  • 10+ years of progressive HR experience
  • Strong HR Business Partnering experience within a multinational environment
  • Demonstrated experience supporting senior business leaders
  • Deep knowledge of Japanese employment practices and labor regulations
  • Strong employee relations and stakeholder management capability

  • Interest in HR technology, AI, and future-of-work trends

  • Significant exposure to regional and global stakeholders
  • Broad remit across business partnering, talent, employee relations, governance, and transformation

job.title: Compliance Manager, Life Science, 18M
job.description:
Compliance Manager 

Leading Healthcare / Life Sciences Company (Japan)

About the Opportunity

An established healthcare organization is seeking an experienced Compliance professional to lead the transformation and modernization of its compliance function.

This role offers a rare opportunity to move beyond maintaining existing processes and instead play a key role in designing, building, and embedding a best-in-class compliance program across the organization. The successful candidate will have significant visibility with senior leadership and the opportunity to shape the future compliance culture of a sizeable business.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the development and enhancement of the company's compliance framework and governance structure.
  • Design and implement compliance policies, procedures, and controls.
  • Oversee whistleblowing, investigations, and case management processes.
  • Promote a strong speak-up culture and increase employee engagement with compliance initiatives.
  • Deliver compliance training and awareness programs.
  • Partner with business leaders to provide practical compliance guidance.
  • Develop compliance reporting and monitoring mechanisms.
  • Build and lead a growing compliance team over time.

Ideal Candidate Profile

  • Experience within the pharmaceutical, healthcare, life sciences, or other highly regulated industries.
  • Proven experience building, implementing, or significantly improving compliance programs.
  • Strong understanding of:
    • Internal reporting / speak-up systems
    • Investigations
    • Compliance risk management
    • Compliance training and culture initiatives
  • Ability to influence stakeholders across multiple business functions.
  • Strong communication and change management skills.
  • Previous people management experience is advantageous but not essential.

Why This Role?

This position offers significantly more than a traditional compliance management role.

The successful candidate will have the opportunity to:

  • Help shape the future compliance culture of a large organization.
  • Build systems and processes rather than simply maintain them.
  • Work closely with senior leadership on strategic initiatives.
  • Drive meaningful organizational change.
  • Develop and grow a compliance team.
  • Gain broad exposure across the business.

This role is particularly attractive for compliance professionals seeking greater ownership, influence, and the opportunity to leave a lasting impact on an organization's operating model and culture.

  • Monitor legal and regulatory developments and advise the business on their impact.
  • Conduct or support internal investigations and whistleblower matters in collaboration with relevant internal teams.
  • Develop and deliver legal training and compliance awareness programs.

  • Excellent analytical, organizational, and problem-solving abilities.

  • Self-motivated, adaptable, and comfortable working across diverse business functions.

Preferred Experience

  • Experience advising businesses in regulated industries.
  • Knowledge of compliance, anti-bribery, competition, employment, privacy, intellectual property, or regulatory matters.
  • Project management or cross-functional project experience.
  • Interest in leveraging AI and technology to improve legal workflows.

Technical Skills

  • Proficiency with standard business applications (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).

Languages

Working Style

The role requires close collaboration with business stakeholders across Japan and within an international organization. The successful candidate should be comfortable working independently while partnering effectively with cross-functional teams in a dynamic environment.

This is an excellent opportunity for a lawyer seeking broad exposure to commercial, regulatory, compliance, governance, and employment matters within a multinational business. job.description:

また、地域金融機関や外部パートナーと連携し、「共創プラットフォーム」を構築しています。この枠組みを通じて、資金提供にとどまらず、経営支援やネットワークの活用など、総合的なサポートを提供しています。企業の課題解決と持続的な成長を後押しする点が特徴です。投資を軸としたビジネスモデルを展開しつつ、投資先企業との長期的なパートナーシップを重視することで、持続可能な成長と社会的価値の創出を実現することを目指しています。

1. コンプライアンス業務の統括

プライベートエクイティファンド運営会社におけるコンプライアンス機能全般をリードしていただきます。具体的には、コンプライアンス体制の構築・高度化（委員会運営を含む）、関連法規の改正への対応、反社会的勢力対応やAML/CFT/CFPに関する管理、顧客情報および投資関連情報の管理を担います。さらに、利益相反の管理や各種コンプライアンスチェック、社内向け研修・教育の企画・実施、内部規程の整備・更新・運用にも関与していただきます。加えて、親会社との各種調整や資料対応、ならびに監督官庁（関東財務局等）への対応も担当範囲に含まれます。

2. 投資案件に関するリスク対応支援

主にバイアウト案件を中心とした投資プロジェクトについて、コンプライアンスおよびレピュテーションリスクの観点から分析を行い、投資担当部門に対して適切な助言・支援を提供します。案件ごとの潜在リスクを踏まえた意思決定を後押しする役割を担います。
